definitions.gloss: junior fellow apprentice; junior pupil (under the same master)
definitions.explanation: A pupil who joined the same master later than oneself, in crafts, traditional arts, sumo or martial arts. Seniority depends on when one entered, not on age.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{私|わたし}→私：02988_watashi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{弟弟子|おとうとでし}だ。
examples.english: He is my junior under the same master.

examples.japanese: {弟弟子|おとうとでし}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{面倒|めんどう}を{見|み}る→面倒を見る：18263_mendouwomiru⟧。
examples.english: To look after one's junior fellow apprentices.

examples.japanese: ⟦{年上|としうえ}→年上：07302_toshiue⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{弟弟子|おとうとでし}⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{入門|にゅうもん}→入門：11643_nyuumon⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{順|じゅん}→順：03342_jun⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{上下|じょうげ}→上下：04282_jouge⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{決|き}まる→決まる：01233_kimaru⟧。
examples.english: Some of my juniors are older than me, but rank is decided by the order in which we entered.

notes:
⟦{弟|おとうと}→弟：00572_otouto⟧ (younger brother) + ⟦{弟子|でし}→弟子：03986_deshi⟧ (pupil). Women are {妹弟子|いもうとでし}.

USAGE:
Used in worlds organized around a master, such as ⟦{落語|らくご}→落語：04457_rakugo⟧, sumo stables, crafts and the traditional arts. Seniority goes by the date of entry.

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{兄弟子|あにでし}→兄弟子：33208_anideshi⟧: senior fellow apprentice
- ⟦{師匠|ししょう}→師匠：12421_shishou⟧: the master
- ⟦{弟子|でし}→弟子：03986_deshi⟧: pupil, apprentice
